turns.text: I'd like to practise a hard parent meeting. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. I'll send END MEETING on its own when I want to stop. I'm Owen's English teacher, and Meredith has just walked into my classroom.
Why am I here, Hale? Owen's essay got a zero and nobody called me.
We've been here two minutes. Who decided on the zero, and before or after anyone spoke to Owen?
Just say okay and I'll write it up as resolved. Okay?
Resolved how? The zero is still in the gradebook.
No. The zero comes off first.
Ms. Kalinowski. I need you to say okay.
You need that for your write-up. I need to know what you have.
